rules: 1 all-in crypto pick per day, 100% deployed
Spot crypto only (BTC, ETH, SOL, and other liquid coins on Robinhood)
Rotate each 6:45am CT run — sell yesterday, buy today's best
Hard stop at entry; leverage conviction, protect downside

positions.name: Ethereum
positions.catalyst: ETH is the flow story this week: US spot ether ETFs took +$84.42M for the week ending Jul 11 — the first net weekly inflow in EIGHT weeks and the largest since late April — part of a combined +$282M BTC/ETH ETF week that snapped the longest outflow streak in these products' history. The staking-ETF narrative is the incremental institutional story ETH has been missing (locks up float, adds yield). Near-term event risk is now two-sided and dated: the Senate returns from recess TOMORROW (Jul 13) with an updated CLARITY Act draft expected mid-July and roughly 20 working days before the Aug 7 recess — a market-structure headline lands squarely inside this 24h window and historically lifts ETH (the DeFi/tokenization proxy) more than BTC.
positions.driver: Relative strength is the tiebreaker and ETH is the ONLY major that is green. Measured on our own dashboard feed 24h-to-24h (Jul 11 11:53Z -> Jul 12 11:53Z): ETH +0.23% ($1,798.41 -> $1,802.54), BTC -0.27% ($64,129.44 -> $63,954.80), SOL -1.26% ($78.02 -> $77.04), XRP -0.96% ($1.1072 -> $1.0966). ETH did what it failed to do twice last week — it RECLAIMED the $1,800 shelf and is holding above it into the Senate's return, which converts former resistance into a clean, definable stop reference. That is the asymmetric setup: a liquid major (deep books, minimal weekend gap risk = downside protection) that is simultaneously the relative-strength leader AND the one with a fresh, quantified flow inflection. Runners-up rejected: BTC (yesterday's pick) is fading despite the biggest ETF book — it has no relative strength left and a CLARITY headline rotates money OUT of dominance and into ETH; SOL is the highest-beta name with a real Q3 catalyst (Alpenglow, ~98% validator support, finality 12s -> 100-150ms) but it is the WEAKEST 24h performer and Alpenglow is a Q3 event, not a next-24h one; XRP keeps bleeding with no fresh catalyst. Entry = dashboard live feed (asOf 2026-07-12T11:53:09Z).
positions.risks: Sentiment is still Extreme Fear (F&G ~23-26) and the ETF reversal is thin — $84M recovers roughly 1% of ETH's ~$9.46B of prior outflows, so this may be tactical rebalancing, not renewed conviction, and it can reverse in a single session. The $1,800 reclaim is only ~0.1% above the shelf; a failed retest flushes back toward $1,750 and a sustained risk-off leg trips the 8% stop at $1,658.34. The CLARITY catalyst cuts both ways: the bill already missed its Jul 4 target, and a 'delayed again / no floor time' headline when the Senate returns Jul 13 would hit ETH harder than BTC. BTC dominance is still elevated (56-58%), which is the wrong regime for an ETH-over-BTC bet if the bid stays defensive. 24/7 headline, dollar and rates risk persists.
